execution: Sequential fresh Node subprocess per case/diagnostic arm; expose-gc; 1GiB process ceiling is execution safety, not retention policy. Timeout/incomplete/error never pass.
instrumentation: Virtual esbuild-only count methods; exact original/instrumented/bundle SHA256 recorded; production files and dist untouched. Null indicates unavailable baseline/current counters.

assertions.R01: 50k confirmed on live tree; final truth/count/diagnostic reader match; active pending/dependency/capture machinery quiet. Confirmed retained diagnostic records explicitly allowed, not called leak.
assertions.R02: 50k rejected on live tree; baseline truth, no confirmed records, active machinery quiet.
assertions.R03: 1000 refused occupied-identity retries preserve pending/state/counts; successful retry after removing conflict drains active machinery.
assertions.R04: One oldest pending plus50k newer accepted same-field writes; terminal accepted handles absent from pending and inspection compact where observable; older reject preserves latest confirmed value. Retained confirmed suffix still has rollback query obligation.
assertions.R05: Destroy with pending retirement; count active obligations with runtime/handle held, assert later settlement/reader refused. Does not claim complete heap reclamation/GC collection.
assertions.R06: Independent fresh processes diagnostics journal on/off with default existing retention settings; compare settlement outcomes and state exactly. Does not assert every outcome legal or cover Redux DevTools UI.

classification: Active correctness, diagnostics, mixed conditional reader obligation, and unknown are separate. Per-subsystem byte attribution and complete outside-workspace consumer inventory unknown. No cap proposed.
